description: Remove one skill from a Thalovant runtime group. This removes only the named skill; the runtime group and its other skills are untouched. Requires the hubs:write scope and a paid plan.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_uninstall_runtime_group_skill
title: Uninstall Runtime Group Skill
